failure: Duplicate PaymentFailed delivery restores seats twice
impact: Sellable seat count is higher than the cabin allows and the flight is oversold
control: Ignore a payment_attempt_id that is already marked applied

failure: Payment failure cancels the booking but capacity restore fails
impact: Seats stay reserved for a booking that will never be paid
control: Keep the booking pending and retry the event when capacity restore fails

failure: Hold expiry and PaymentFailed both release the same seats
impact: One failed payment returns the seats twice
control: Only the first successful release may restore capacity

failure: Late PaymentFailed cancels a booking that was already confirmed
impact: A paid traveler loses a confirmed seat
control: Quarantine PaymentFailed when the booking is already confirmed

failure: Displayed total and captured amount differ
impact: Traveler is charged a different amount from the fare they accepted
control: Reject confirmation unless the captured amount equals the held total

failure: Unknown booking reference still changes a flight seat count
impact: Capacity moves with no matching booking
control: Record the event and do not call the capacity service
